name: Getting Rid Of Evil
overview: Scripture reveals that overcoming evil begins with heeding God's commandments, as promised in Deuteronomy 28:1, which leads to exaltation above the nations. The Lord, our Shepherd, provides for and protects His people, ensuring they lack nothing (Psalms 23:1). Even Jesus faced temptation by the devil in the wilderness (Matthew 4:1), demonstrating the reality of evil and the need for spiritual vigilance. Righteousness must stand firm against wickedness, for yielding to evil corrupts the character, as Proverbs 25:26 warns.
